courses.title: Programming from Zero
courses.blurb: Algorithms, flowcharts and Python basics — explained for someone who has never written code. Covers 18.09–26.10 lectures and the full exercise sheet.

courses.title: Differential Equations I
courses.blurb: Weeks 1–6: separable, exact, linear, Bernoulli, homogeneous, Riccati and Clairaut equations, applications and higher-order linear equations. Includes the 2023 midterm, solved.

courses.title: Türk Dili I
courses.blurb: Dil ve kültür, dillerin sınıflandırılması, Türkçenin alfabeleri, Türk dilinin tarihî gelişimi (I–III) ve modern Türkçenin yayılma alanları.
